purpose: prospective new-data replication of the already frozen antecedent score; no retuning during the prospective window

panels.score_ranking_rule: rank separately within each frozen 500-stock panel on the same T; pooled-1000 metrics are auxiliary only

score.cross_section: same-T percentile rank within frozen panel

outcome.entry: next normal stock trading day open after T; no jumping if missing/untradeable
outcome.event_seed: exact top 10% of valid H60 MFE observations within each frozen panel
outcome.event_anchor: earliest T in transitive G7 seed component
outcome.corporate_action_rule: fail-closed exclusion for action within T..H60 using official evidence
outcome.maturity_rule: observation remains pending_maturity until entry plus complete 60 stock trading days and corporate-action evidence are available

prospective_governance.source_policy: official TWSE/public issuer evidence only for new prospective raw inputs; archive raw payload/page evidence, fetch timestamp and SHA-256 under research-only GCS
prospective_governance.missing_policy: missing or unresolved official evidence remains unknown/pending; never impute canonical facts

acceptance_not_evaluated_until: sufficient post-2026-09-16 observations have fully matured through H60; no early pass/fail claim
